sections.heading: Scope of Cover
sections.body: This certificate evidences that the employees of the Policyholder named in the Schedule, together with their enrolled dependants, are covered on a family floater basis for In-patient Hospitalisation expenses, Pre-hospitalisation (30 days) and Post-hospitalisation (60 days) expenses, Day Care Procedures, Domiciliary Hospitalisation and Ambulance charges, subject to the terms, conditions and exclusions of the Master Policy.

sections.heading: Special Conditions Applicable to this Group
sections.body: Waiver of 30-day initial waiting period, waiver of pre-existing disease exclusion and waiver of first-year exclusions. Maternity benefit covered with a sub-limit as per the Member Benefit Table. Room rent restricted to 1% of individual floater cover for normal room and 2% for ICU. Co-payment of 10% applicable for parents if enrolled at a later endorsement.

sections.heading: Claims Procedure
sections.body: Cashless facility is available at network hospitals through the in-house Health Administration Team of the Company. Intimation of planned hospitalisation must be given at least 48 hours in advance and emergency hospitalisation within 24 hours of admission on Toll Free No. 1800-210-4477 or email healthclaims@kaveriassurance.example. Reimbursement claims must be submitted within 30 days of discharge.

sections.heading: Grievance Redressal
sections.body: In case of any grievance, the insured may contact the Grievance Officer, Kaveri Assurance Co. Ltd., at the Registered Office address. If the grievance is not resolved within 15 days, the insured may approach the Bima Bharosa portal of IRDAI or the Insurance Ombudsman, Pune, as per the Insurance Ombudsman Rules, 2017.

sections.heading: Important Notice
sections.body: This certificate is issued in accordance with the Master Policy held by the Policyholder and is subject to realisation of premium. Insurance is the subject matter of solicitation. The Master Policy wording, Member Benefit Table and list of enrolled members form part of this certificate. Any alteration in this certificate renders it void.
